'''Guy Kargl''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Red 61 FL from Tulsa, Oklahoma. His slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="smlist" /> He was a call-in guest on [[Radio Free Decipher]] broadcast 9 (26 February 1999) with Chris Swearingen, [[Alex Alcalde]] and [[Carl Mike Hardy|Mike Hardy]].<ref name="rfd-09">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QU24jFxZsHM Radio Free Decipher 09], Player's Council (26 February 1999). Guests Chris Swearingen, [[Alex Alcalde]], Mike Hardy, and [[Guy Kargl]]. Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-QU24jFxZsHM Internet Archive].</ref>
